title: Altered gravity fields
text: Microgravity shifts fluid toward the head, unloads bone and muscle, and changes heart, pressure and temperature regulation.
Daily resistive and aerobic countermeasures, plus fluid and salt protocols, slow the loss; the app tracks body mass, pressure and temperature trends against the personal baseline.
Dizziness on return to gravity is expected: move slowly and sit before standing.

citations.source: NASA Human Research Program: the five hazards of human spaceflight — altered gravity fields.
